title: Preclinical Restorative Competency (GENDT888, Preclinical Skills Assessment)
description: Assesses rising third-year students' competency in basic restorative dentistry; written and manual exam over two consecutive days.

title: Simulated Dental Patient Competency I (GENDT842)
description: Manual assessment of operative techniques; passing confers operative competency / EPA status in clinic.

title: Dental Clinical OSCE (GENDT850)
description: Performance-based assessment of clinical reasoning using structured questions on clinical scenarios.

title: Simulated Dental Patient Competency II (GENDT843)
description: Manual assessment of endodontic, fixed prosthodontic and implant techniques performed on a typodont.
